counterfactual_missing_items: No explicit stress or exercise trigger documented in the vignette
No family history of sudden cardiac death or arrhythmias
No mention of exercise testing or epinephrine challenge
decisive_items: repetitive monomorphic premature ventricular complexes with atypical left bundle-branch block/left axis deviation–like morphology and short-coupling interval of 240 milliseconds
recurrent episodes of polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, some deteriorating into ventricular fibrillation
variant of unknown significance in the coding gene of cardiac ryanodine receptor (RyR2)
response.rationale: R3 directly matches the core ECG findings (polymorphic VT, short-coupled PVCs) and the RyR2 variant, forming a coherent CPVT diagnosis. C1 is an append-only completion of R3, adding the RyR2 VUS to the label but relying solely on the genetic span; it does not independently capture the ECG phenotype. R4 is contradicted by normal echocardiography and lacks the polymorphic VT pattern.

rejected.why: Normal cardiac structure on echocardiography contradicts ARVC, and the ECG pattern is more consistent with CPVT than ARVC.
